## Standards

<a id="Iso8601"></a>

### ISO 8601 dates

`Iso8601` · `src/measures.ts:29`

Calendar dates ("2026-10-17"): year, month and day in the extended format, in the Gregorian calendar. Months go from 01 to 12; every month has at least 28 days.

Source: ISO 8601-1:2019, calendar dates in the extended format (§ 5.2.2), in the Gregorian calendar · `https://www.iso.org/standard/70907.html`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `dateLength` | `10` | YYYY-MM-DD: the characters of a calendar date in the extended format |
| `yearLength` | `4` | YYYY: the characters of the year, which open a calendar date |
| `calendarDate` | `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` | The pattern of a calendar date in the extended format: four digits, two, two, joined by hyphens |
| `firstMonth` | `1` | January |
| `lastMonth` | `12` | December |
| `firstDay` | `1` | The first day of a month |
| `shortestMonth` | `28` | The days that every month has (February, in a common year) |
| `timeDesignator` | `T` | Between the date and the time of day, in a date and time (§ 5.4.1) |

<a id="LanguageTags"></a>

### Language tags

`LanguageTags` · `src/measures.ts:66`

A language written as a tag of subtags (fr, fr-CH, en-GB): the language first, then its script or its region, separated by hyphens; Java's locales, and the voices of Android, write an underscore instead.

Source: IETF BCP 47 (RFC 5646), Tags for Identifying Languages, § 2.1; Java SE, Locale.toString (the form Android reports) · `https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc5646`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `separator` | `-` | Between the subtags of a language tag |
| `localeSeparator` | `_` | Between the language and the region of a locale, as Java and Android write it |

- Maintained by: trame
- Serves: [A published value is cited, not copied](product.md#CitedNotCopied)
- Used by: [The browser's voice](platform.md#BrowserSpeech)

<a id="SemanticVersioning"></a>

### Semantic versioning

`SemanticVersioning` · `src/measures.ts:50`

A version as major.minor.patch: a change of major breaks what used the package; under 1.0.0, a change of minor does.

Source: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0, §§ 2, 4, 8 · `https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `separator` | `.` | Separates the major, the minor and the patch |
| `initial` | `0` | The major of a package in its initial development: its minor then breaks what uses it |

- Maintained by: trame
- Serves: [A published value is cited, not copied](product.md#CitedNotCopied)

<a id="UnitsOfMeasure"></a>

### Units of measure

`UnitsOfMeasure` · `src/measures.ts:12`

A minute is 60 seconds and an hour 3,600 (the non-SI units accepted for use with the SI); a percent is a hundredth.

Source: BIPM, The International System of Units (SI Brochure, 9th edition), Table 8 and § 5.4.7 · `https://www.bipm.org/en/publications/si-brochure`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `minute` | `60` | The seconds of a minute |
| `hour` | `3600` | The seconds of an hour |
| `percent` | `100` | The hundredths of a whole: a ratio times 100 is a percentage |

- Maintained by: trame
